title: Hellenistic temple rituals of Babylon and Uruk (Babylon Akītu ritual; Uruk rituals, TU 38–44) / Ритуалы Вавилона и Урука селевкидского времени
author: Anonymous priests (Seleucid-era copies)
edition: Thureau-Dangin, Rituels accadiens (1921; public domain, archive.org); Linssen, The Cults of Uruk and Babylon (2004).
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka ('акиту ритуал перевод', 'Урук эллинистический ритуал') finds no translation; possible excerpts in В.В. Емельянов's ritual studies (unverified).
en_evidence: Linssen 2004 (not re-verified online); partial in ANET (Sachs).
value: Cult in Seleucid Babylonia, including the king's ritual humiliation at the Akītu. Crucial for Hellenistic kingship, Antiochus I, Berossus and Greek–Babylonian interaction.
ai_feasibility: medium-high: prose instructions; the public-domain French edition gives transliteration. Sumerian incantation passages are harder.
pilot_unit: Babylon Akītu ritual (DT 15, DT 109, MNB 1848), est. c. 450 lines
